posts.title: Meta releases its first frontier model, Muse Wonder
posts.summary: Meta Superintelligence Labs follows the lightweight Muse Spark with Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full — larger models Meta says post higher benchmark scores and stronger results on complex tasks like coding.

posts.title: Meta's new frontier model Muse Wonder Full breaks into the AI top tier
posts.summary: Muse Wonder models rank top three on six of ten benchmarks, with the biggest gains on agentic tasks — but cost per task has nearly tripled versus Meta's earlier models.

posts.title: Microsoft's new AI chip makes it less reliant on Nvidia's GPUs
posts.summary: Microsoft unveils Maia 300, its third-generation in-house AI chip, built to be the primary inference system for its products and better suited to reasoning models and agentic workloads.

posts.title: Microsoft debuts multichiplet Maia 300 inference accelerator
posts.summary: Microsoft says Maia 300 processes 40% more tokens per megawatt than leading GPU systems; the Maia line becomes Azure's main inference platform from 2027 at multi-gigawatt scale.

posts.title: Nvidia reportedly in early talks to buy, acquihire or invest more in Reflection AI
posts.summary: SiliconANGLE / FT: Nvidia is in early talks to acquire open-weight model developer Reflection AI or deepen its stake (already ~$800M invested) — options include full buy, more equity, compute deal, or acqui-hire; agreement possible within weeks but talks could still collapse. Reflection just launched Beam.

posts.title: Report: Amazon in talks with AI startup Decart over possible $7B acquisition
posts.summary: SiliconANGLE: Amazon is reportedly discussing a potential acquisition of AI developer Decart.ai that could be worth up to $7B — Decart builds software that helps developers run AI models across different hardware backends; no company confirmation yet.

posts.title: White House reverses course and restores UK AI Safety Institute's access to frontier models
posts.summary: After telling Anthropic, Google DeepMind and OpenAI in September to stop sharing models with the UK agency, the Trump administration restored the AISI's early access following diplomatic pressure from UK AI minister Kanishka Narayan.

posts.title: Microsoft President Says Milk and Washing Machines Face More Safety Regulations Than AI
posts.summary: Brad Smith calls for stronger global AI safety rules as systems grow more powerful, arguing everyday products face tougher oversight than AI companies.

posts.title: Microsoft president says UK is best placed to drive AI regulation
posts.summary: Brad Smith urges urgent AI regulation and says the UK is well positioned to lead it, repeating that milk and washing machines get more oversight than AI.

posts.title: Google DeepMind's AlphaProof Nexus solved dozens of open math problems and actually got peer reviewed
posts.summary: Per a study in Science, AlphaProof Nexus solved dozens of open problems including nine Erdős problems — two unsolved for 56 years — with results peer reviewed before publication.

posts.title: Mistlabs takes its Ambi AI system out of beta on Apple devices with $26M in funding
posts.summary: Ambient-intelligence startup Mistlabs, led by former Plaud exec Peter Mo, launches Ambi — an always-listening assistant designed to act without being asked — backed by $26M in new funding.

posts.title: Nvidia tackles AI factory scaling bottlenecks with open rack designs and networking advances
posts.summary: At the Open Compute Project Global Summit, Nvidia contributed Vera Rubin rack and compute-tray designs plus networking advances aimed at agentic AI infrastructure.

posts.title: Anthropic's Andrej Karpathy says "the external world has seen the preview" of what AI can actually do
posts.summary: Karpathy, now at Anthropic, describes a widening gap: about 75% of people have barely touched LLMs while roughly 5,000 insiders use frontier agent swarms doing years of expert work.

posts.title: Sakana AI's self-improving model gets better at solving and judging, but can't catch its own blind spots
posts.summary: Sakana's MASS method has one model solve, judge and refine its own workflows, hitting a ~70% win rate over the base model after two rounds — but shared blind spots get reinforced as false progress.

posts.title: Clearing chat history helps AI agents find better solutions
posts.summary: Microsoft researchers find agents get stuck in "idea basins" as context grows; their Fork-and-Flush method wipes chat history but keeps the workspace, improving results up to 66% on the same compute.

posts.title: Meet the Anthropic Engineer Keeping Its AI Agent Trustworthy
posts.summary: IEEE Spectrum profiles Anthropic's Gurmeet Saran, who builds infrastructure to understand how Claude's agent retrieves information and to make its outputs reliable.

posts.title: Import AI 476: Creativity and RSI; worse-than-China open weight models; AI goes to space
posts.summary: Jack Clark's weekly newsletter on AI creativity and recursive self-improvement, open-weight models lagging Chinese releases, and AI heading to space.

posts.title: Silicon Valley is falling in line with Trump's attempt to rename AI
posts.summary: The Verge: Musk, Benioff, Huang and now Nadella are adopting Trump's "super intelligence" rebrand after a Sept 29 EO directing federal agencies to say SI instead of AI — Nadella used the phrasing in his emergency-brake post.

posts.title: Ukraine Has Dealt a Big Blow to Russia's AI and Cloud Infrastructure
posts.summary: Gizmodo: Ukrainian drone strikes hit Yandex and other Russian data-center sites (including AI training supercomputers near Sasovo), disrupting cloud services and the Alice voice assistant — expanding the war into Russia's AI compute base.

posts.title: The AI Data Center Boom Is Causing a Gigantic Spike in Smog-Spewing Gas Power Plants
posts.summary: Futurism (via Environment America / Electrek): AI infrastructure demand is driving plans for ~44% more US gas-fired generator capacity by 2030 (~20 GW), while planned wind capacity falls ~34% — locking in decades of fossil dependence for data-center power.

rumors.title: OpenAI reportedly in talks with Katzenberg-backed startup to revive Sora
rumors.summary: UNCONFIRMED X chatter: @aseatrades says OpenAI is reportedly in talks with an undisclosed AI video startup founded by Jeffrey Katzenberg, ex-Sora lead Bill Peebles and ex-Dropbox CFO Sujay Jaswa to bring Sora back, with OpenAI possibly taking equity — no deal announced; treat as rumor. oEmbed verified morning 13 Oct (HTTP 200).

rumors.title: DeepSeek reportedly leading robotics startup Winverse AI's seed round at $400M valuation
rumors.summary: UNCONFIRMED X chatter: @webulite's headline roundup cites sources saying DeepSeek agreed to lead a seed round of tens of millions of dollars for robotic AI startup Winverse AI at a $400M post-money valuation — no company confirmation; treat as rumor. oEmbed verified morning 13 Oct (HTTP 200).

rumors.title: Anthropic reportedly signed a multiyear AI cloud deal with IREN (The Information)
rumors.summary: UNCONFIRMED X chatter: @wallstengine says The Information reports Anthropic signed a multiyear cloud deal with $IREN; IREN's Aug filing disclosed a multi-year contract with an unnamed "leading frontier AI lab" — neither company has confirmed the Anthropic link; treat as rumor. oEmbed re-verified morning 13 Oct (HTTP 200).

rumors.title: Broadcom reportedly arranging $50B+ in debt to fund OpenAI's custom chips
rumors.summary: UNCONFIRMED X chatter: @YouYouFXRESERCH relays a report that Broadcom is arranging more than $50B in financing for the custom chips it is co-developing with OpenAI, with Apollo and Blackstone among lenders in talks — no company confirmation; treat as rumor only. oEmbed re-verified morning 13 Oct (HTTP 200).
